{{Top|leg}}
A '''visual scanner''' was a simple [[Security scanner/Legends|security scanner]], recording images and sound. Some models were equipped with long-range magnifiers or optics that allowed it to see in the [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] or [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] spectrums.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
